t.zh: 这句话的谓语是 is。它不是一个动作，后面也没有动作落到的东西；它只是把主语和后面那一块连起来，说主语是什么。这样的动词叫。
t.en: This sentence’s verb is is. It is no action, and nothing after it is acted on; it only links the subject to what follows, saying what the subject is. Such a verb is a .

t.zh: 系动词后面那一块叫<wiki-ref to="complement"></wiki-ref>。主干是主语、谓语、表语。
t.en: What follows a linking verb is its <wiki-ref to="complement"></wiki-ref>. The skeleton is then subject, verb, complement.

title.zh: The main contribution of this paper is a new loss function for imbalanced data.
title.en: The main contribution of this paper is a new loss function for imbalanced data.

body.zh: 主干 The main contribution is a new loss function：本文的主要贡献是一个用于不平衡数据的新损失函数。论文里交代贡献、定义、结论，常常就是这样一个“主语 is 表语”。
body.en: The skeleton is The main contribution is a new loss function. Papers state contributions, definitions and findings in just this shape: subject, is, complement.

note.zh: 系动词后面是表语，说明主语是什么。
note.en: After a linking verb comes a complement: what the subject is.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers away.

hint.zh: is 后面那一块，是在说主语是什么吗？
hint.en: Is what follows is saying what the subject is?

tasks.sentence: The main contribution of this paper is a new loss function for imbalanced data.

*.zh: is 后面跟的不是宾语：它不说动作落在什么上，而是说主语是什么。
*.en: What follows is is no object: it does not say what is acted on, but what the subject is.
